frames.supervisor_strategy: We are at 100/100 HP in daytime with a completed valid house to our left, two Wooden Bows (slots 8-9), 62 Wood, 77 Dirt Blocks, 36 Stone Blocks, Gel, and a Torch. The controller is stuck inside the cave mouth 4 tiles below the grass because a narrow overhanging lip leaves less than a 2-tile gap overhead (blocked.above=true) and holding D+SPACE with Wood selected cannot clear the 4-tile right dirt wall. We will switch to the Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and run mine_clear_overhead to widen the mouth to open sky, then run pillar_up with Dirt Blocks to reach the surface grass. From there we will chop one surface tree to reach 85+ Wood, craft Torches, a Furnace, full Wood Armor, and 150+ Arrows at the house Work Bench, and then descend into caves for Lead Ore, Chests, and Life Crystals before prepping the Eye of Cthulhu arena.

tasks.task: Select Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and run mine_clear_overhead to break the overhanging grass and dirt tiles at dx=-1..+1, dy=-1..-4 above the player.

tasks.task: Run pillar_up using Dirt Blocks (or Wood in slot 4) to build 3-4 tiles upward out of the cave mouth onto the surface grass, then walk left onto flat grass near the house.
tasks.done_when: Player is standing on surface grass outside the pit with blocked.left and blocked.right both false.

tasks.task: Select Copper Axe (slot 3) and chop 1 nearby surface tree (such as the tree on the right hill or left of the house) to raise Wood from 62 to at least 85.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in HUD/inventory is >= 85.

tasks.task: Walk inside the house next to the Work Bench, open inventory (Esc), craft 9+ Torches, a Furnace, Wood Helmet, Wood Breastplate, Wood Greaves, and 150+ Wooden Arrows, then equip the Wood Armor.
tasks.done_when: Wood Armor is equipped and Furnace + 150+ Arrows + Torches are in inventory.

tasks.task: Place the Furnace in the house, then descend into the cave shaft using dig_down / stairs_down_left while placing Torches to mine the Lead Ore vein and search deeper caves for Chests and Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: 24+ Lead/Iron/Silver/Gold Ore mined and first Life Crystal or underground Chest found.

steps: Switch to Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and run mine_clear_overhead to remove the narrow grass/dirt lip blocking the pit opening.
Run pillar_up 3-4 tiles onto the surface grass and walk left toward the house.
Chop 1 surface tree with Copper Axe (slot 3) so Wood reaches 85+.
Inside the house at the Work Bench, craft Torches, Furnace, Wood Armor (equip all 3 pieces), and 150+ Wooden Arrows.
Place the Furnace and dig into caves with Torches to mine the nearby Lead Ore vein, Chests, and Life Crystals.
avoid: Holding D+SPACE or A+SPACE continuously against the 4-tile pit wall without mining the overhead lip first
Staying on hotbar slot 4 (Wood) when mining is required instead of switching to slot 2 (Copper Pickaxe)
Pressing Esc while inventory is already closed during pit escape
Mining any Wood tiles or doors belonging to the valid house on the left
plan.done_when: Player is on the surface with full Wood Armor equipped, a Furnace crafted, and 150+ Arrows ready for cave exploration.

frames.supervisor_strategy: We are at 100/100 HP in daytime with a completed valid house to our left, two Wooden Bows (slots 8-9), 62 Wood, 77 Dirt Blocks, 36 Stone Blocks, Gel, and a Torch. The controller is stuck inside the cave mouth 4 tiles below the grass because a narrow overhanging lip leaves less than a 2-tile gap overhead (blocked.above=true) and holding D+SPACE with Wood selected cannot clear the 4-tile right dirt wall. We will switch to the Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and run mine_clear_overhead to widen the mouth to open sky, then run pillar_up with Dirt Blocks to reach the surface grass. From there we will chop one surface tree to reach 85+ Wood, craft Torches, a Furnace, full Wood Armor, and 150+ Arrows at the house Work Bench, and then descend into caves for Lead Ore, Chests, and Life Crystals before prepping the Eye of Cthulhu arena.

tasks.task: Walk inside the house next to the Work Bench, open inventory (Esc), craft 9+ Torches, a Furnace, Wood Helmet, Wood Breastplate, Wood Greaves, and 150+ Wooden Arrows, then equip the Wood Armor.

tasks.task: Place the Furnace in the house, then descend into the cave shaft using dig_down / stairs_down_left while placing Torches to mine the Lead Ore vein and search deeper caves for Chests and Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: 24+ Lead/Iron/Silver/Gold Ore mined and first Life Crystal or underground Chest found.

steps: Switch to Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and run mine_clear_overhead to remove the narrow grass/dirt lip blocking the pit opening.

Place the Furnace and dig into caves with Torches to mine the nearby Lead Ore vein, Chests, and Life Crystals.
avoid: Holding D+SPACE or A+SPACE continuously against the 4-tile pit wall without mining the overhead lip first

Pressing Esc while inventory is already closed during pit escape
Mining any Wood tiles or doors belonging to the valid house on the left
plan.done_when: Player is on the surface with full Wood Armor equipped, a Furnace crafted, and 150+ Arrows ready for cave exploration.

tasks.task: Smelt bars at the Furnace to craft an Anvil and metal gear, build two 40-tile rows of Wood Platforms with a Campfire near the house, and obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye.

frames.supervisor_strategy: We have ~100/100 HP in daytime, a completed valid house just left of us, 62 Wood, 36 Stone Blocks, 77 Dirt Blocks, 8 Torches, Gel, and two Wooden Bows. The agent is stuck 4 tiles down in a narrow pit right of the house because an overhanging Wood tile and grass lip narrow the top opening to 1 tile wide, causing all 8 steps of pillar_up to have NO EFFECT. First we will use the Copper Pickaxe with stairs_up_left to cut away the left overhang and ramp straight out onto the flat grass in front of the house. Next we will chop one surface tree to reach 85+ Wood, craft and equip full Wood Armor, a Furnace, and 150+ Arrows at the Work Bench inside our house, and then mine the visible Lead Ore vein and deeper caves for Life Crystals and metal upgrades before building the Eye of Cthulhu arena.

plan.objective: Exit the pit onto the surface grass via stairs_up_left, gather 85+ Wood, and craft/equip full Wood Armor, a Furnace, and 150+ Arrows at the house Work Bench.

tasks.task: Select Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and run stairs_up_left to mine the overhanging Wood tile and left dirt/grass lip (dx=-3..0, dy=-1..-4) and walk onto the flat surface grass outside the house.
tasks.done_when: Player is standing on the flat surface grass left of the pit with unblocked horizontal access to the house right door.

tasks.task: Select Copper Axe (slot 3) and chop 1-2 surface trees near the house using chop_tree_left until Wood reaches at least 85.
tasks.done_when: 85+ Wood in hotbar/inventory.

tasks.task: Walk inside the house beside the Work Bench, open inventory (Esc), craft and equip Wood Helmet, Wood Breastplate, and Wood Greaves, and craft 1 Furnace plus 150+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
tasks.done_when: Wood Helmet, Wood Breastplate, and Wood Greaves equipped, Furnace crafted, and 150+ Arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Enter the cave shaft with Copper Pickaxe and Torches, mine the Lead Ore cluster near (-18, +8), and continue into deeper caves with stairs_down_left/dig_down for Iron/Lead/Gold Ore, Chests, and Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: 30+ metal ore collected and max HP raised to 140+ from Life Crystals.

tasks.task: Smelt bars at the Furnace to craft an Anvil and metal gear, build two 40-tile rows of Wood Platforms with a Campfire near the house, and obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye.
tasks.done_when: 2-row Wood Platform arena with Campfire built, upgraded metal bow/armor equipped, and Suspicious Looking Eye in inventory.

steps: Use Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) with stairs_up_left to break the overhanging Wood and left grass lip and climb onto the flat grass by the house.
Chop 1-2 surface trees near the house with Copper Axe until reaching 85+ Wood.
Stand at the Work Bench inside the house, open inventory, craft and equip full Wood Armor, and craft a Furnace and 150+ Arrows.
Mine the nearby Lead Ore vein and explore deeper caves with Torches for more ore, Chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt ore into bars for an Anvil and stronger gear, build a multi-tier platform arena with a Campfire, and prepare a Suspicious Looking Eye for night.
avoid: Running pillar_up inside the narrow pit while the overhanging Wood block and 1-tile grass lip block a 2-tile-wide player jump (produced 8 consecutive NO EFFECT steps).
Mining downward at (0, +2) or (+1, +2) beneath the player's feet when trying to exit the pit.
Mining any wall, roof, or door tiles of the completed house to the left.
Holding Left Mouse on the same tick as pressing a hotbar key when switching tools.
plan.done_when: Player is out of the pit with full Wood Armor equipped, a Furnace crafted, and 150+ Arrows ready in inventory.

tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.

Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Close inventory if open, walk right inside the house to the door at dx=+10, right-click the door to open it and step outside, then chop nearby surface trees with Copper Axe (slot 3) using chop_tree_right (or jump over the house roof to chop the left trees) until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
avoid: Do not run chop_tree_left from inside the house—the left wall is solid Wood with no door, causing every step to have NO EFFECT.
Do not trigger movement or tool routines while the inventory screen is open.
Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

Once geared with full Wood Armor and a Wooden Bow + arrows, we will mine the Lead Ore vein right below the house and push into deeper caves for Life Crystals, chests, and metal upgrades toward the Eye of Cthulhu.

tasks.task: Close inventory if open, walk right inside the house to the door at dx=+10, right-click the door to open it and step outside, then chop nearby surface trees with Copper Axe (slot 3) using chop_tree_right (or jump over the house roof to chop the left trees) until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
avoid: Do not run chop_tree_left from inside the house—the left wall is solid Wood with no door, causing every step to have NO EFFECT.
Do not trigger movement or tool routines while the inventory screen is open.
Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

plan.objective: Exit through the right house door, gather 60+ Wood, place the Furnace, and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus 250+ Arrows at the Work Bench.

tasks.task: Close inventory if open, walk right inside the house to the door at dx=+10, right-click the door to open it and step outside, then chop nearby surface trees with Copper Axe (slot 3) using chop_tree_right (or jump over the house roof to chop the left trees) until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
avoid: Do not run chop_tree_left from inside the house—the left wall is solid Wood with no door, causing every step to have NO EFFECT.
Do not trigger movement or tool routines while the inventory screen is open.
Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

Once geared with full Wood Armor and a Wooden Bow + arrows, we will mine the Lead Ore vein right below the house and push into deeper caves for Life Crystals, chests, and metal upgrades toward the Eye of Cthulhu.

tasks.task: Close inventory if open, walk right inside the house to the door at dx=+10, right-click the door to open it and step outside, then chop nearby surface trees with Copper Axe (slot 3) using chop_tree_right (or jump over the house roof to chop the left trees) until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
avoid: Do not run chop_tree_left from inside the house—the left wall is solid Wood with no door, causing every step to have NO EFFECT.
Do not trigger movement or tool routines while the inventory screen is open.
Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Close inventory if open, walk right inside the house to the door at dx=+10, right-click the door to open it and step outside, then chop nearby surface trees with Copper Axe (slot 3) using chop_tree_right (or jump over the house roof to chop the left trees) until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
avoid: Do not run chop_tree_left from inside the house—the left wall is solid Wood with no door, causing every step to have NO EFFECT.
Do not trigger movement or tool routines while the inventory screen is open.
Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

frames.supervisor_strategy: The agent escaped the pit, entered the valid house (100/100 HP, daytime), crafted a Furnace, and crafted/equipped a Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, leaving 7 Wood, 16 Stone Blocks, 86 Dirt Blocks, and 1 Gel. Recent chop_tree routines had NO EFFECT because the agent tried chopping left through the solid left house wall and tried chopping right while the inventory was open and the right door (dx=+10) was closed. Next we will walk to the right door, open it with right-click, step outside to chop surface trees to 60+ Wood, then finish full Wood Armor (Wood Greaves), place the Furnace, and craft 250+ Arrows at the Work Bench. Once geared with full Wood Armor and a Wooden Bow + arrows, we will mine the Lead Ore vein right below the house and push into deeper caves for Life Crystals, chests, and metal upgrades toward the Eye of Cthulhu.

plan.objective: Exit through the right house door, gather 60+ Wood, place the Furnace, and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus 250+ Arrows at the Work Bench.

tasks.task: Close inventory if open, walk right inside the house to the door at dx=+10, right-click the door to open it and step outside, then chop nearby surface trees with Copper Axe (slot 3) using chop_tree_right (or jump over the house roof to chop the left trees) until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
avoid: Do not run chop_tree_left from inside the house—the left wall is solid Wood with no door, causing every step to have NO EFFECT.
Do not trigger movement or tool routines while the inventory screen is open.
Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.

Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

frames.supervisor_strategy: The agent escaped the pit, entered the valid house (100/100 HP, daytime), crafted a Furnace, and crafted/equipped a Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, leaving 7 Wood, 16 Stone Blocks, 86 Dirt Blocks, and 1 Gel. Recent chop_tree routines had NO EFFECT because the agent tried chopping left through the solid left house wall and tried chopping right while the inventory was open and the right door (dx=+10) was closed. Next we will walk to the right door, open it with right-click, step outside to chop surface trees to 60+ Wood, then finish full Wood Armor (Wood Greaves), place the Furnace, and craft 250+ Arrows at the Work Bench. Once geared with full Wood Armor and a Wooden Bow + arrows, we will mine the Lead Ore vein right below the house and push into deeper caves for Life Crystals, chests, and metal upgrades toward the Eye of Cthulhu.

plan.objective: Exit through the right house door, gather 60+ Wood, place the Furnace, and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus 250+ Arrows at the Work Bench.

tasks.task: Close inventory if open, walk right inside the house to the door at dx=+10, right-click the door to open it and step outside, then chop nearby surface trees with Copper Axe (slot 3) using chop_tree_right (or jump over the house roof to chop the left trees) until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Stand inside the house near the Work Bench, place the Furnace on an open floor tile, then open inventory to craft and equip Wood Greaves (25 Wood) and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows using Stone Blocks, Wood, and Torches.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves are equipped alongside Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate, Furnace is placed, and 250+ Arrows are in inventory.

tasks.task: Dig underground below the surface with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and Torches, first mining the visible 8-tile Lead Ore vein at dy=+7..+8 and then descending into caves with dig_down / stairs_down_right to collect ore, loot chests, and mine/use Life Crystals.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or chest weapons/accessories) collected.

tasks.task: Return to the placed Furnace and Work Bench in the house, smelt ore into bars, craft and place a Lead/Iron Anvil, and craft upgraded metal armor and a metal bow.
tasks.done_when: Lead/Iron Anvil is placed and metal armor/bow are equipped.

tasks.task: Build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide) above the surface grass with a Campfire, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye (from a chest or 6 Lenses at an Altar), and summon/defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Walk to the right door of the house, right-click to open it, step outside, and chop surface trees until Wood >= 60.
Return to the house Work Bench, place the Furnace on the floor, craft/equip Wood Greaves, and craft 250+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
Mine the Lead Ore vein just below the house and dig deeper into caves with Torches to gather ore, chests, and Life Crystals.
Smelt bars at the Furnace, craft/place a Lead Anvil, and upgrade armor and bow.
Build a 2-tier surface platform arena, obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye, and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at Night.
avoid: Do not run chop_tree_left from inside the house—the left wall is solid Wood with no door, causing every step to have NO EFFECT.
Do not trigger movement or tool routines while the inventory screen is open.
Do not mine any blocks, walls, roof tiles, or the door of the completed house.
Do not get trapped in narrow 1-tile-wide pit openings without clearing overhanging lips with the Copper Pickaxe.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (Helmet, Breastplate, Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed inside the house, and Wooden Bow has 250+ arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Descend deeper into underground caves using stairs_down_right and dig_down while placing Torches, mining Lead/Silver/Gold Ore, looting chests, and mining and using Life Crystals until Max HP >= 140 and metal ore >= 45.

frames.supervisor_strategy: The agent has a valid house, 100/100 HP in daytime, Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate equipped, a Wooden Bow, 1 Furnace, 16 Stone Blocks, 1 Gel, and 7 Wood, and has stepped outside to the slope east of the covered pit. In the controller trace, repeated chop_tree_right and chop_tree_left calls produced NO EFFECT because those routines do not jump over 1-tile dirt steps and the nearest trees are 14 to 25 tiles away. First we must jump-walk over the uneven terrain to stand directly beside surface tree trunks (the tree up the right slope at dx=+14 and the grove beside and west of the house) and chop until Wood >= 60. Next we return inside the house to place the Furnace, craft and equip Wood Greaves, and stock 200+ Arrows, then mine the nearby Lead Ore vein and push into deeper caves for Life Crystals, chests, and metal upgrades for the Eye of Cthulhu.

plan.objective: Gather 60+ Wood by jumping to surface tree bases, then place the Furnace inside the house and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus 200+ Arrows.

tasks.task: Select Copper Axe (slot 3), jump-walk (D+SPACE up the right slope to the tree at dx=+14, dy=-5, then A+SPACE left across the bridge and over the house roof to the western trees) until standing within 3 tiles of each tree trunk, and chop the base trunks until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Enter the house through a door and close it, place the Furnace on the floor inside the house, stand near the Work Bench, and open inventory (Esc) to craft and equip Wood Greaves (20 Wood) plus craft Torches and 200+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves equipped, Furnace placed inside the house, and total Arrows >= 200.

tasks.task: Select Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and dig down into the cave beneath the covered pit right of the house, placing Torches as needed, to mine the shallow Lead Ore vein until Lead Ore >= 15.
tasks.done_when: Lead Ore count in inventory is >= 15.

tasks.task: Descend deeper into underground caves using stairs_down_right and dig_down while placing Torches, mining Lead/Silver/Gold Ore, looting chests, and mining and using Life Crystals until Max HP >= 140 and metal ore >= 45.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and combined Lead/Silver/Gold Ore >= 45 (or Lead Anvil crafted).

steps: Jump-walk over 1-tile terrain steps to reach nearby surface tree trunks within 3 tiles and chop them with Copper Axe until Wood >= 60.
Go inside the house, place the Furnace, and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus Torches and 200+ Arrows at the Work Bench.
Dig into the cave below the pit right of the house and mine the shallow Lead Ore cluster until Lead Ore >= 15.
Explore deeper caves with Torches to collect 45+ metal ore, chest loot, and Life Crystals to reach 140+ Max HP.
avoid: Triggering chop_tree_right or chop_tree_left while more than 4 tiles from a tree or blocked by a 1-tile dirt step (blocked.right or blocked.left true), as those routines do not jump and yield NO EFFEC
Mining any walls, roof tiles, floor tiles, or doors of the valid house.
Opening inventory to craft while standing outside away from the Work Bench or exposed to slimes.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (including Wood Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed in the house, and Wooden Bow with 200+ Arrows is ready for cave exploration.

frames.supervisor_strategy: The agent has a valid house, 100/100 HP in daytime, Wood Helmet and Wood Breastplate equipped, a Wooden Bow, 1 Furnace, 16 Stone Blocks, 1 Gel, and 7 Wood, and has stepped outside to the slope east of the covered pit. In the controller trace, repeated chop_tree_right and chop_tree_left calls produced NO EFFECT because those routines do not jump over 1-tile dirt steps and the nearest trees are 14 to 25 tiles away. First we must jump-walk over the uneven terrain to stand directly beside surface tree trunks (the tree up the right slope at dx=+14 and the grove beside and west of the house) and chop until Wood >= 60. Next we return inside the house to place the Furnace, craft and equip Wood Greaves, and stock 200+ Arrows, then mine the nearby Lead Ore vein and push into deeper caves for Life Crystals, chests, and metal upgrades for the Eye of Cthulhu.

tasks.task: Select Copper Axe (slot 3), jump-walk (D+SPACE up the right slope to the tree at dx=+14, dy=-5, then A+SPACE left across the bridge and over the house roof to the western trees) until standing within 3 tiles of each tree trunk, and chop the base trunks until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Enter the house through a door and close it, place the Furnace on the floor inside the house, stand near the Work Bench, and open inventory (Esc) to craft and equip Wood Greaves (20 Wood) plus craft Torches and 200+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves equipped, Furnace placed inside the house, and total Arrows >= 200.

tasks.task: Select Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and dig down into the cave beneath the covered pit right of the house, placing Torches as needed, to mine the shallow Lead Ore vein until Lead Ore >= 15.
tasks.done_when: Lead Ore count in inventory is >= 15.

tasks.task: Descend deeper into underground caves using stairs_down_right and dig_down while placing Torches, mining Lead/Silver/Gold Ore, looting chests, and mining and using Life Crystals until Max HP >= 140 and metal ore >= 45.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and combined Lead/Silver/Gold Ore >= 45 (or Lead Anvil crafted).

steps: Jump-walk over 1-tile terrain steps to reach nearby surface tree trunks within 3 tiles and chop them with Copper Axe until Wood >= 60.
Go inside the house, place the Furnace, and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus Torches and 200+ Arrows at the Work Bench.
Dig into the cave below the pit right of the house and mine the shallow Lead Ore cluster until Lead Ore >= 15.
Explore deeper caves with Torches to collect 45+ metal ore, chest loot, and Life Crystals to reach 140+ Max HP.
avoid: Triggering chop_tree_right or chop_tree_left while more than 4 tiles from a tree or blocked by a 1-tile dirt step (blocked.right or blocked.left true), as those routines do not jump and yield NO EFFEC
Mining any walls, roof tiles, floor tiles, or doors of the valid house.
Opening inventory to craft while standing outside away from the Work Bench or exposed to slimes.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (including Wood Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed in the house, and Wooden Bow with 200+ Arrows is ready for cave exploration.

First we must jump-walk over the uneven terrain to stand directly beside surface tree trunks (the tree up the right slope at dx=+14 and the grove beside and west of the house) and chop until Wood >= 60. Next we return inside the house to place the Furnace, craft and equip Wood Greaves, and stock 200+ Arrows, then mine the nearby Lead Ore vein and push into deeper caves for Life Crystals, chests, and metal upgrades for the Eye of Cthulhu.
plan.objective: Gather 60+ Wood by jumping to surface tree bases, then place the Furnace inside the house and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus 200+ Arrows.

tasks.task: Select Copper Axe (slot 3), jump-walk (D+SPACE up the right slope to the tree at dx=+14, dy=-5, then A+SPACE left across the bridge and over the house roof to the western trees) until standing within 3 tiles of each tree trunk, and chop the base trunks until Wood >= 60.
tasks.done_when: Wood count in hotbar/inventory is >= 60.

tasks.task: Enter the house through a door and close it, place the Furnace on the floor inside the house, stand near the Work Bench, and open inventory (Esc) to craft and equip Wood Greaves (20 Wood) plus craft Torches and 200+ Wooden/Flaming Arrows.
tasks.done_when: Wood Greaves equipped, Furnace placed inside the house, and total Arrows >= 200.

tasks.task: Select Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) and dig down into the cave beneath the covered pit right of the house, placing Torches as needed, to mine the shallow Lead Ore vein until Lead Ore >= 15.
tasks.done_when: Lead Ore count in inventory is >= 15.

tasks.task: Descend deeper into underground caves using stairs_down_right and dig_down while placing Torches, mining Lead/Silver/Gold Ore, looting chests, and mining and using Life Crystals until Max HP >= 140 and metal ore >= 45.
tasks.done_when: Max HP >= 140 and combined Lead/Silver/Gold Ore >= 45 (or Lead Anvil crafted).

steps: Jump-walk over 1-tile terrain steps to reach nearby surface tree trunks within 3 tiles and chop them with Copper Axe until Wood >= 60.
Go inside the house, place the Furnace, and craft/equip Wood Greaves plus Torches and 200+ Arrows at the Work Bench.
Dig into the cave below the pit right of the house and mine the shallow Lead Ore cluster until Lead Ore >= 15.
Explore deeper caves with Torches to collect 45+ metal ore, chest loot, and Life Crystals to reach 140+ Max HP.
avoid: Triggering chop_tree_right or chop_tree_left while more than 4 tiles from a tree or blocked by a 1-tile dirt step (blocked.right or blocked.left true), as those routines do not jump and yield NO EFFEC
Mining any walls, roof tiles, floor tiles, or doors of the valid house.
Opening inventory to craft while standing outside away from the Work Bench or exposed to slimes.
plan.done_when: Full Wood Armor (including Wood Greaves) is equipped, Furnace is placed in the house, and Wooden Bow with 200+ Arrows is ready for cave exploration.
